app.message: Service app mounts the container engine socket /var/run/docker.sock, which does not exist on Kubernetes nodes
app.hint: Remove the mount; use the Kubernetes API from a sidecar instead.

app.message: Service app mounts the container engine socket /run/podman/podman.sock, which does not exist on Kubernetes nodes
app.hint: Remove the mount; use the Kubernetes API from a sidecar instead.

app.message: Bind source /srv/shop/shared must exist on every node that may run app
Bind /srv/shop/shared of service app uses shared propagation, which Kubernetes allows only for privileged containers
Bind source /srv/shop/ro-slave must exist on every node that may run app
Bind /srv/shop/ro-slave of service app asks for bind.recursive: readonly with rslave propagation, which Kubernetes cannot combine
